title: Naturally Smoky Kenyan Portobello Mushrooms Skewers
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Kenyan dish featuring smoky portobello mushrooms, fajita seasoning, and a crispy exterior, perfect for a festive gathering.

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: Thread mushroom slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each slice.
In a small bowl, mix together fajita seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mushroom skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with the seasoning mixture.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and lightly charred.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
